vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.issue: The meta description is only 53 characters, which is too short to use the available search snippet space.
vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.fix: Rewrite the meta description as: "Applied AI engineer building generative pipelines and RAG tools that help marketing and creative teams ship work faster."
evidence: check_meta_tags.description = Applied AI engineer for marketing and creative teams.

vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.issue: No canonical link is set, so duplicate URL variants could compete in search.
vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.vinnayakk.com"> to the page head.

vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.issue: Render-blocking CSS delays first paint, and unused JavaScript is shipped (including Google Tag Manager).
vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.fix: Load the Google Tag Manager/gtag script with the afterInteractive or lazyOnload strategy so it doesn't compete with initial render.
vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.note: The issue names render-blocking CSS, but the fix only changes GTM loading. The fix doesn't address its own issue.

vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.issue: The only H1 is a generic greeting rather than a descriptive heading, so the main heading carries no topic keywords.
vinnayakk-com-20261014-162653.fix: Change the H1 to a descriptive heading such as "Applied AI engineer for marketing and creative teams".

vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.issue: Mobile LCP is 3.3 s, and the LCP element is the cookie-consent banner text rather than page content.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.fix: Make the cookie banner a small fixed-position overlay with short text, so it is not the largest element painted. Alternatively, make sure the main heading or content paints larger than the banner.
evidence: check_speed.lcp_element = This site uses cookies to understand how visitors use it and to measure the eff…
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.note: The banner fix is plausible (it's site-wide), but speed on a 404 page matters little, so medium is too high.

vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.issue: The Google Tag Manager script (176 KB) is the heaviest resource on the page. Lighthouse also flags 99 KiB of unused JavaScript and render-blocking requests.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.fix: Load the gtag/GTM script with the Next.js Script component using strategy="afterInteractive" or "lazyOnload", so it doesn't block rendering.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.note: GTM isn't shown as render-blocking. Also low value on a 404 page.

vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.issue: Legacy JavaScript is being shipped to modern browsers.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.fix: Update the browserslist config in the project to target modern browsers, so Next.js stops adding unneeded polyfills and transforms.

vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.issue: The 404 template has no Open Graph tags and a 53-character meta description. This only matters if real pages share the same head template.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.fix: Check a real page such as the homepage. If it also lacks og:title, og:description and og:image, add them in the shared Next.js metadata config, and lengthen the description to 70–160 characters.
vinnayakk-com-this-page-does-not-exist-2.note: Good conditional fix: check the real page first.
